name: wheel-csp-cc-mirror
description: Backtest mirror of the live alpaca-wheel-agent engine (wheel.py + config.py), no re-tuning
decision_cadence: weekly new entries (Monday or next trading day); daily TP/roll/expiry/CC management

csp_entry.selection: nearest to target delta among qualifying (mirrors wheel.py _best)

put_management.assignment: expiry Friday stock close < strike -> buy 100/contract at strike

covered_call.called_away: expiry Friday stock close > strike -> deliver at strike

dividends: paid on ex-date while shares held (Alpaca corporate-actions feed, raw/corporate_actions.json)
ai_layer: NOT replayed - backtest bounds the deterministic core; live AI can only veto/halve (risk-reducing)
sharpe: daily returns, sample std (N-1), rf=0, annualized sqrt(252)
